records.text: Candace Owens said the Trump administration sent a delegation to the Saint Petersburg International Economic Forum.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Just so you guys know, this is the most hilarious part. Trump administration sent an entire delegation to this.

verification.notes: A sitting Trump-appointed U.S. official, Rodney Mims Cook Jr., attended SPIEF and Russian organizers described an American delegation. Secretary of State Marco Rubio testified that he was unaware of any such delegation and did not identify it as an administration-sent high-level delegation. Attendance is established; formal Trump-administration sponsorship is not.

sources.title: SPIEF 2026 Was A Tragicomic Encapsulation of Russia’s Economic Quagmire
sources.relevance: Reports the American attendees and that Rubio said it was not an official delegation.

sources.title: Marco Rubio Questioned About Steven Seagal Representing U.S. in Russia
sources.relevance: Quotes Rubio saying he was unaware of the delegation while identifying Cook as a sitting U.S. official at SPIEF.

records.text: An unidentified embedded commentator said Vladimir Putin personally asked Candace Owens to speak at the convention.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep YeEtS7nix3o)

appearances.snippet: So the latest is Putin himself has just asked Candace Owens to speak today at this convention.

verification.notes: The embedded clip establishes that an unidentified commentator made the claim, but live searches found no authoritative program record or Putin-office confirmation that Putin personally invited Owens to speak. Attempted but unverifiable.

records.text: Ben Shapiro said Candace Owens attended and spoke at the Saint Petersburg International Economic Forum alongside Vladimir Putin, Alexander Dugin, and Russian government and intelligence figures.
records.speaker: Ben Shapiro

verification.notes: Reuters footage confirms Owens spoke at SPIEF, and reporting confirms Putin and Dugin participated in the same forum. The wording alongside is broad, however, and research did not establish that Owens shared a panel with Putin, Dugin, or identified Russian intelligence officials.
